items.rationale: Theft damage to the frame is covered under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b). It falls in the EUR 500 aggregate mobility sub-limit (4.2.2), which also absorbs the recovery costs; covered lines total about 1,018 gross, so a rateable factor of about 0.49 applies to roughly 250.
Theft damage to the brakes is covered. About 140 gross, cut rateably under the 500 sub-limit (factor about 0.49).
A tracking device that was not itself affected and was replaced after the loss is excluded under 4.2.3 and 3.1.7.
Servicing of an unaffected item is excluded under 3.1.6, 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a)/(b).
Supplementary or protective equipment not affected by the event is excluded under 4.2.3 and 3.1.7.
Carriage of replacement parts is a repair cost under 7.1.7(f). About 26 gross, cut rateably under the sub-limit.
Trade attendance is a repair cost under 7.1.7(g). About 77 gross, cut rateably under the sub-limit.
Fitting replacement parts is a repair cost under 7.1.7(c). About 113 gross, cut rateably under the sub-limit.
Sundries are nominally covered under 7.1.7(e), but this line type was never indemnified before and its purpose is unspecified. Any amount would be small and cut rateably.
Labour of every grade on the covered repair is included under 7.1.7(d). About 35 gross for 1 hour, cut rateably.
Covered repair labour, about 40 gross for 1 hour at this edition's revealed rate, cut rateably under the sub-limit.
Attendance at the recovery site is covered under 5.2.2(a) but falls within the bike sub-limit. About 35 gross, cut rateably.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Cutting the lock is covered under 5.2.2(b). About 108 gross for 2 pcs, cut rateably under the 500 aggregate sub-limit.
There is no indication the second attendance was actually required by the recovery, so it is excluded under 7.1.8(f)/(g).
A charge required by a third party to release the bike is covered under 5.2.2(c): 100 plus VAT = 119, cut rateably under the sub-limit.
Claim-processing charges are excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(d).
Labour of every grade on the lock work is covered under 5.2.2(b). About 35 gross for 1 hour, cut rateably.
Recovery labour is covered under 5.2.2(b). About 40 gross for 1 hour, cut rateably.
